GOS.Dialog.OptFlatten: Store assets in collective folders (assets/<type>/…) instead of original paths
GOS.Dialog.OptAssetTarget: Target folder for assets (empty = original path)
GOS.Dialog.NothingToImport: No files were found for this type.
GOS.Notify.NoToken: No GitHub token configured. Enter one in the module settings.
GOS.Notify.BadRepo: Invalid GitHub repository. Use the form "owner/repo" in the module settings.
GOS.Notify.PushConflict: Export failed: the GitHub branch was changed by another party several times during the export (e.g. a concurrent export), so nothing could be saved. Please wait a moment and trigger the export again. (Details: {detail})
GOS.Settings.SyncAssets.Name: Sync assets (images/maps)
GOS.Settings.SyncAssets.Hint: Also sync referenced images, maps and audio so objects can be exported and imported completely.
GOS.Settings.GithubRepo.Name: GitHub repository
GOS.Settings.GithubBranch.Name: GitHub branch
GOS.Settings.GithubBranch.Hint: The branch to read from and write to (default: main).
GOS.Settings.GithubToken.Name: GitHub token
GOS.Settings.GithubToken.Hint: A fine-grained Personal Access Token with Contents read/write for the repository. Stored in the world settings; only the GM can see it.
GOS.Settings.OverwriteImport.Name: Overwrite on import
GOS.Settings.OverwriteImport.Hint: When an object with the same ID already exists, update it on import instead of creating a duplicate.
GOS.Settings.ExportFlattenAssets.Name: Export: store assets in collective folders
GOS.Settings.ExportFlattenAssets.Hint: When enabled, all assets are stored on export as "assets/<type>/<filename>" (e.g. assets/Item/sword.webp) and references inside the objects are rewritten accordingly. When disabled, the full original paths are kept.
GOS.Settings.ImportAssetPrefix.Name: Import target folder for assets
GOS.Settings.ImportAssetPrefix.Hint: Optional subfolder inside the data directory where imported images/maps are written (e.g. "git-import"). Asset paths inside imported objects are rewritten accordingly. Leave empty to use the original paths.
GOS.Settings.ImportFolderMode.Name: Import: folder behaviour
GOS.Settings.ImportFolderMode.Hint: Determines which sidebar folder imported objects are placed in: the same folder as on export (recreated if needed), no folder (root), or a fixed, self-named folder.
GOS.Settings.ImportFolderName.Name: Import: fixed folder name
GOS.Settings.ImportFolderName.Hint: Name of the folder that all imported objects are placed in when folder behaviour is set to "Fixed folder" (e.g. "Git Import").
